brief: faction questline builder — roster, ranks with real requirements, 3+ questlines to a rank ceiling, mutual exclusion, topic ids that exist
findings: game/data/progression/factions.json (2 factions, house-dres/shadowscale-order) is a WAVE-0 SKELETON and is NOT the ladder of record. tools/lib/gamedata.mjs:90-97 says so explicitly and returns it separately under .skeleton.

The real ladder of record is game/data/quests/faction-gates.json — 9 entries, 8 ranks each, 2 favoured attrs / 6 favoured skills each, consumed live by game/src/engine.js:308 via FactionGates (game/src/sim/quest/gate.js).
faction-gates.json has a DUPLICATE faction: ixtu_vakh and the_ixtu_vakh are byte-identical ladders under two ids. Only the_ixtu_vakh is referenced by any quest.
Quest census: 69 quests total, 11 category=faction spread across 8 different factions — i.e. no questline anywhere, max 3 quests in one faction (the_dockhands).

faction-gates.json ladders are machine-generated by tools/analysis/gen-faction-gates.mjs and are IDENTICAL across all 9 factions (rep 0/10/25/40/55/70/85/100, attr null/25/30/35/45/55/65/75, skills 20..80). No faction expresses a build.
canOffer() in gate.js uses topicsInclude() (core/topics.js) for opens_by.topic — slug/prose tolerant. Still must exist as a topic id somewhere.

MEASURED, 240 signatures (10 races x 4 upbringings x 6 classes) through the SHIPPED character builder: the highest favoured attribute a fresh character has is 19, and every faction ladder asks 25 at RANK 1. 0 of 240 signatures can hold rank 1 in ANY faction at creation, and the sweep is tools/quests/faction-signature-sweep.mjs.

Attributes rise ONLY at +1 per 15 skill levels in the governing skill (character/derive.js:359). Governed-skill counts: agility 6, strength 3, intellect/willpower/personality 2, endurance/speed/vigour/hist-bond 1, luck 0. Best-case ceiling = 19 + 6*count: agility 55, strength 37, intellect/willpower/personality 31, endurance/speed/vigour/hist-bond 25, luck 19. The shipped rank-7 attribute of 75 is UNREACHABLE BY ARITHMETIC for every faction in the build.
RI-QST03 §A states Morrowind s own top-rank favoured attribute is ~33-34. The generated ladder asks 75 — 2.2x the figure the item it cites is built on.

THREE factions favour the attribute "intelligence", which does not exist. The sheet has "intellect". the_imperial_assize, the_xul_aneekh and deep_kin each therefore have one dead favoured attribute; the Assize is worst hit (its live attribute floor drops to 3).

Q-LEDG-01 res_blackmail unlocks Q-LEDG-04 and res_expose locks Q-LEDG-04. Q-LEDG-04 DOES NOT EXIST. QuestBook._check only validates top-level consequences.unlocks/locks, never resolution-level ones, so the dangling reference boots clean.

game/data/quests/hooks.json is STALE against its own generator on purpose — W1-19 round 2 hand-rewrote every entry_topics row to point FORWARD. Running tools/analysis/gen-quest-hooks.mjs would re-introduce the self-loop defect that made 0 of 32 main quests offerable. Hand-edit hooks.json; never regenerate it.

Baselines before my changes: check-data 360 files PASS, check-content 205 resolutions, boot-check PASS. tools/analysis/build-viability.mjs CRASHES (topics.js:69 it is not iterable via canOffer) — pre-existing, not mine.
MEASURED after the ladder fix: rank-1 attribute demand met at CREATION by 104-192 of 240 signatures per faction (was 0/240 for all nine). No dead favoured attributes remain.

26 DANGLING RESOLUTION-LEVEL QUEST REFERENCES across the shipped book (Q-ARCH-01, Q-BLAK-01, Q-DEEP-01, Q-DOCK-01, Q-LILM-01, Q-SAP-01, Q-SOUL-02, Q-STRM-01 all lock or unlock quests that do not exist). QuestBook._check validates only TOP-LEVEL consequences.unlocks/locks, so none of them is visible at boot. Q-LEDG-04 was one of the 26 and is now written.

FactionGates.closedBy() — the ENTIRE X1/X4/X2 mutual-exclusion model — had NO CONSUMER anywhere in game/src/. machine.js initialised rivalry_locked:[] on every standing row and never wrote it. A player could hold rank 7 in the Wet Ledger and rank 7 in the Assize that exists to hang it, in one save. QuestEngine.context() is now the reader; the lock lands in ctx.locked and canOffer() speaks a reason.

topic-supply audit over the whole tree: 34 quest topics EXIST NOWHERE in dialogue/topics/**, and 35 hooks.json entry_topics rows are still SELF-LOOPS (W1-19 repaired only the Q-MAIN rows). None of the 34 or 35 is on the three carried lines. Tool: tools/quests/topic-supply-audit.mjs.

BLOCKING, ANOTHER AGENT: game/data/npcs/pop-*.json (8 files, written 13:51) declare reaction_group RG-COMMON, which is not in progression/race-reactions.json. derivedDisposition() THROWS on it, out of QuestEngine.dispositionView() -> context() -> offers(). questOffers() is dead for the whole build while those files are on disk. 182 records affected.

MEASURED, all three lines, live: faction-probe now PASSES 11/11 on the_wet_ledger, the_imperial_assize and the_xul_aneekh — 9/9 quests each offerable from a COLD START through questOffers(), rank 0 -> 7 derived, walked entirely NON-VIOLENTLY, 34-38 world flags raised by the resolutions themselves.

THE LADDER CLAMPED AT RANK 3 OF 7. The shared attribute column [_,12..24] was asserted reachable against ATTR_AT_CREATION_MAX=19 (the best of 240 signatures) + 6 per governed skill grinding every skill to 90 — a best case twice over. Driven live, the Wet Ledger reached reputation 112 (the rank-7 demand) and stopped at DERIVED RANK 3, because agility had only reached 16 against a demand of 24. 3 of 9 quests reachable.

THE ARITHMETIC NOBODY HAD DONE: taking the two skills the ladder ITSELF grades from a median sheet to the rank-7 demands (70/35) crosses at most FOUR multiples of 15, so a whole faction ladder pays +4 attribute — while the spread between signatures at creation is 6 to 19. The attribute term cannot carry a rank ladder in this build; reputation (0->112) and the skill columns (20->70) do. The column is now derived per faction from reports/faction-signature-sweep.json.

MUTUAL EXCLUSION FIRED ON REPUTATION, NOT MEMBERSHIP. machine.js used held = max(derived rank, member?1:0). Q-ASSZ-04 res_hide_vell pays the Drowned Court 20 for hiding a witness — on the Assize s own instructions — which derived Drowned Court rank 1 and made the ASSIZE refuse its own rank-5 quest: "will not deal with you: you are The Drowned Court". 4 of 9 quests unreachable. heldRank() now requires an authored joins_faction.

NOTHING IN THE FACTION BOOK EVER JOINED A FACTION. joins_faction appeared in exactly one file in the tree (mainline-act4.json). Every ending of each entry quest (Q-LEDG-00, Q-ASSZ-00, Q-XULA-00) now carries it — 7 resolutions — so joining is an authored act with a scene around it and the exclusion has something real to key on.

TWO DEAD-END QUESTS, both at a line ceiling: Q-ASSZ-06 asked personality 20 on all three endings and Q-XULA-08 asked willpower 24 on three of four. MEASURED per-attribute ceilings (base + 6 per governing skill, 240 signatures): personality 18 / willpower 22 / hist-bond 16 / intellect 18 from a p10 sheet. Both quests had NO reachable ending. Lowered to 16 and 20. Instrument: tools/quests/resolution-reachability.mjs.

The same audit finds 19 further out-of-reach endings across the book that are NOT dead ends (a build the player did not take), including pre-existing Q-MAIN-08 personality 40, Q-MAIN-13 willpower 35, Q-MAIN-23 personality 45, Q-MAG-10 strength 45, Q-BLAK-01 personality 45 — every one of them above the max-sheet ceiling for that attribute. Not mine; reported.
game/src/harness/api.js had a WRITER for world flags (questSetFlag) and NO READER. "The quest changes the world" was unverifiable from outside. questWorldFlags() added.
